title: PCEP: Improve rendering of flags in LSP Object
description:
The LSP object's flags were not rendering a summary. Using `proto_tree_add_bitmask` improves that.

Also, the PLSP-ID had unnecessarily leading 8 bits.

Before:
```
LSP object
    Object Class: LSP OBJECT (32)
    0001 .... = LSP Object-Type: LSP (1)
    .... 0000 = Object Header Flags: 0x0
        ...0 = Ignore (I): Not set
        ..0. = Processing-Rule (P): Not set
        00.. = Reserved Flags: Not set
    Object Length: 76
    .... .... 0000 0000 0000 0000 0001 .... = PLSP-ID: 1        <---
    Flags: 0x00102a                                             <---
        .... .... .... ...0 = Delegate (D): Not set
        .... .... .... ..1. = SYNC (S): Set
        .... .... .... .0.. = Remove (R): Not set
        .... .... .... 1... = Administrative (A): Set
        .... .... .010 .... = Operational (O): ACTIVE (2)
        .... .... 0... .... = Create (C): Not set
        .... 0000 .... .... = Reserved: Not set
```

After:
```
LSP object
    Object Class: LSP OBJECT (32)
    0001 .... = LSP Object-Type: LSP (1)
    .... 0000 = Object Header Flags: 0x0
        ...0 = Ignore (I): Not set
        ..0. = Processing-Rule (P): Not set
        00.. = Reserved Flags: Not set
    Object Length: 76
    0000 0000 0000 0000 0001 .... = PLSP-ID: 1
    Flags: 0x102a, SYNC (S), Administrative (A), Operational (O): ACTIVE
        .... .... .... ...0 = Delegate (D): Not set
        .... .... .... ..1. = SYNC (S): Set
        .... .... .... .0.. = Remove (R): Not set
        .... .... .... 1... = Administrative (A): Set
        .... .... .010 .... = Operational (O): ACTIVE (2)
        .... .... 0... .... = Create (C): Not set
        .... 0000 .... .... = Reserved: Not set

```
